prompts.name: 01-cartes-denses
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: high fidelity French mobile web screenshot for Coliclic outgoing booking requests list.
Input image role: design reference and base layout. Generate a refined variant closely based on the attached compact-card design, NOT a different app.
Portrait 948x1659 pixels, flat screenshot edge to edge, no device frame or perspective. EXACT palette: navy #023047, cyan #219EBC, orange #FB8500, background #FAFAFA, white cards, border #E8E8EC, gray secondary #6B6B6B. Green #10B981 accepted, amber #F59E0B pending, red #EF4444 rejected, gray cancelled, with darker text on very pale status pills. Poppins type. Never purple, gradients, photography or large illustrations.
Preserve compact brand header: hamburger, small wordmark "Coliclic" with Coli orange and clic navy, circular navy AT avatar. Title "Demandes envoyées", secondary "6 demandes", cyan text link "Trouver un voyageur", not a big button. Compact modern white cards on pale background, restrained rounded corners and borders, no nested cards. Each whole card navigates to its SEPARATE detail page via right chevron; no expanders or modal. SIX COMPLETE CARDS visible on screen simultaneously. Cities never truncated.
Same six cards in exact order and exact information:
"Nantes → Abidjan" / "Poisson · 3 kg" / "Acceptée"
"Paris → Dakar" / "Vêtements · 5 kg" / "En attente"
"Lyon → Lomé" / "Livres · 2 kg" / "Acceptée"
"Bordeaux → Cotonou" / "Chaussures · 4 kg" / "En attente"
"Marseille → Douala" / "Documents · 1 kg" / "Refusée"
"Lille → Bamako" / "Jouets · 2 kg" / "Annulée".
No other data in cards: no countries, reference, date, recipient, contact, phone, message button, cancellation button, progress, payment or shipment delivery information. Use legible realistic equivalent mobile type sizes route 14-16px, subtitle 12-13px and statuses 11px. Avoid unnecessary blank space, keep all six cards entirely visible. No footer/navbar.
VARIANT 1: DENSER QUIET CARDS. Make the header and cards noticeably more compact than reference with reduced padding and 6 logical px gaps. Route alone on first line, parcel + weight on second line at left and small status pill on second line at right. Right chevron vertically centered at far right. Move status away from route to give long routes generous width. Six white slim outlined cards, 8px corner radius, no shadows, no pictograms, confident clean typography. Short header. This must visibly improve efficient scanning while keeping spacious touch targets.
